description: This file defines an in-memory implementation of the NotesSyncService interface, handling synchronization of notes by pushing and pulling note data within an application.

classes.name: InMemoryNotesSyncService
classes.description: Implements NotesSyncService to simulate remote synchronization of notes using in-memory storage.

methods.name: pushNotes
methods.description: Accepts a list of notes and stores them into the in-memory remote store, updating the internal map accordingly and touching the clock to simulate server time.

methods.name: pullNotes
methods.description: Retrieves notes from the in-memory store that have been updated since the specified time in milliseconds.
